art_direction: 宽而低的黑上缘连入偏左黑瞳，下笔不齐，白缺口靠内，无眉短嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Pull two wide low black strokes across the upper eye edges. Let each spread downward into a large pupil placed toward the left. The lower eye marks remain short and detached, one ending sooner than the other. Cut blunt paper notches into the inward sides of the black pupils, avoiding round dots. Keep enough open space for both eyes to read as awake. No brows. A small, slightly crooked mouth sits beneath the gap.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
